title: Comparison of Home Treatment and Inpatient-Treatment in patients with mental disorders and behavioral problems
summary: We want to compare if Home Treatment is as effective as an In patient treatment for behavioral problems in patients with mental retardation
conditions: Children with mental retardation/neurodevelopmental disorder and behvioral problems

interventions.name: Patients with mental retardation and behavior problems, receiving in patient therapy in a social pediatric center
Patients with mental retardation and behavior problems, who have received Home Treatment

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Mental Developmental Disorder and Behavior Problems as diagnosis for inpatient therapy
Exclusion criteria:
- Insufficient German knowledge for questionnaires 
- Participation in the first home treatment study
